artboards.title: Calls and texts on a customer
Texting setup: number and carrier approval

annotations.text: HandsFreeOS Milestone 3: Communication. Same system as Milestones 1 and 2 (clean & airy, accent #2D69D8, Hanken Grotesk). Every screen is clickable: open conversations, reply, assign, snooze and close in the Inbox; answer, mute and hang up on the Calls screen; buy a number and walk through the carrier approval; add a domain and check its DNS records. The Preview chips above some screens jump to a state (a ringing call, quiet hours, a turned-down registration). Accent and Theme chips recolor a screen or switch it to dark.
Sample data only: Lone Star HVAC & Roofing is a fictional client workspace of Go Biz Help. People, phone numbers, domains and messages are placeholders (555 numbers and .test domains).

Phone: Inbox joins the bottom bar (Home, Inbox, Customers, Pipeline, More) and Tasks moves into More. A conversation opens full screen without the bar; the i button holds the customer, assign, snooze and close.

Each conversation is one customer on one channel: Mike's texts are one thread, his email another. Switching the composer to Email in a text thread sends the email into Mike's email thread. The customer's page still shows every channel together on the timeline.
